title: coord.py --url with a malformed host ends in a ValueError or UnicodeError traceback and exit 1
goal: coord.py checks a --url it cannot split or encode (an unclosed IPv6 bracket, a host label over 63 characters) and exits 2 with a one-line reason, as BG-gmaaoumg made a bad port do, never a traceback or exit 1 (the 'key held' code). Found by the SP-fp3hxl6q review (S3, BG-gmaaoumg).

run:
import os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
D=tempfile.mkdtemp();k=os.path.join(D,'k');open(k,'w').write('a'*40);os.chmod(k,0o600)
bad=[]
for u in ('http://[::1','https://'+'a'*70+'.com'):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','--url',u,'--key-file',k,'get','x'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60,env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.db')))
    print(u[:20],'exit',p.returncode,'Traceback' in p.stderr)
    if p.returncode!=2 or 'Traceback' in p.stderr: bad.append(u)
sys.exit(0 if not bad else 1)

notes: Review 2026-10-18: urllib.parse.urlsplit at coord.py:898 is unguarded.
